blocks.title: Red flags
blocks.text: Red flags are signs that a source may be unreliable: no author information, sensational headlines, or no references.

A website with no clear author or contact information may be unreliable. Relying on unverified sources can spread misinformation and lead to poor decisions, so always verify the origin, check the author's credentials and look for bias or sensationalism (Be cautious).
